newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks mostly lower in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks mostly lower in London.

text.p: Most Japanese shares sank further in London, though trading volume remained light, dealers said.
By 1416 GMT, the Nikkei 50 average was down 17.60 points in London to 1,401.98, weighed down by continued selling in construction issues, they said.
Dealers noted light bargain hunting in some big blue chips, like Nikon and NEC but said the general consensus was that the benchmark Nikkei 225 average is headed toward the 18,000 level.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 average tumbled 215.81 points, or 1.14 percent, to 18,680.39, its lowest close since Nov 29, 1995.
